quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Dante DiVincenzo's expected role in the Timberwolves' rotation
quotes.excerpt: it's always been very important for him to be in the starting lineup. The things have to change
quotes.quote: I'm really fascinated by what you think Dante DiVincenzo's role will be whenever he comes back. You've talked about it before that it's always been very important for him to be in the starting lineup. The things have to change for him.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' front office stance on trading Dante DiVincenzo
quotes.excerpt: we're not trading him like he is part of our future. And you hear that all the time

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: We've heard that Dante DiVincenzo is incredibly popular with the coaching staff and the organization. Steve, how would you assess the fan view of Dante DiVincenzo?

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Terry
text_blocks.text: I definitely think he's the heartbeat of part of the team. What is interesting is you hear Tim Connelly and Matt Lloyd and they're like, 'Nope, we're not trading him like he is part of our future.' And you hear that all the time and then they get traded.

quotes.speaker: Steve Terry
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love's potential fit with the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I cannot believe you haven't talked about the best player coming off the bench named Kevin Love.
quotes.quote: I cannot believe you haven't talked about the best player coming off the bench named Kevin Love. I think he'd be a great fit, but just as a fan, when he first came to the team, he was so fun. He was so happy. He was in the community.

quotes.speaker: Steve Terry
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels' new commercial and personality
quotes.excerpt: Jaden McDaniels is on the team. We are stoked. Next week we're actually filming some commercials
quotes.quote: Actually, Jaden McDaniels is on the team. We are stoked. Next week we're actually filming some commercials. We're going to have several hours with him and he's gone through the scripts. We got some really good ideas. It is going to be kind of reminiscent of what we did with Naz where it's going to be more fun, try to show some personality.

quotes.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
quotes.summary_phrase: Preference for a championship ring over sustained high-level success
quotes.excerpt: would you rather have a local franchise that you care about win a championship and have that

text_blocks.speaker: Jon Krawczynski
text_blocks.text: Would you rather have a local franchise that you care about win a championship and have that be a lone peak, or would you rather have a run of high-level competence where you're in the playoffs every year, maybe deep playoff runs every year, but you don't get that ultimate ring?

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Terry
text_blocks.text: I want the ring. I've had 20 years of shit. I'm ready for a ring.
